title: dryas octopetala subsp. integrifolia
intro: Dryas octopetala subsp. integrifolia, commonly known as Mountain Avens or Alpine Rose, is a plant species that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae) and is native to alpine regions of Europe and Asia. The Mountain Avens has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, which may help in wound healing and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Avens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
